start.title: A New House
start.text:
You stand in a stranger's courtyard.
Potiphar, captain of Pharaoh, watches you.

choices.feedback: You would be hunted as a runaway.

choices.text: Bow and serve with all your heart
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:4 — Joseph found favor in Potiphar's sight and served him.
Potiphar laughs coldly. You are a slave.

run_consequence.title: Nowhere to Go
run_consequence.text:
The gate is guarded. The desert is wide.
You turn back inside.

choices.feedback: You will trust God where He has placed you.

demand_consequence.title: Silence the Pride
demand_consequence.text:
A guard's hand falls hard on your shoulder.
Pride will not free you.

choices.feedback: Your knee touches the cool stone.

serve_well.title: The Lord Is With You
serve_well.text:
Each task you touch prospers.
Potiphar begins to notice.

choices.text: Steal grain to keep for yourself
choices.feedback: A slave's hand must be clean.

choices.text: Give God the glory in silence
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:3 — Potiphar saw that the Lord was with Joseph and that the Lord made all he did to prosper in his hand.

choices.text: Boast of your skill to others
choices.feedback: Boasting will draw envy, not favor.

steal_consequence.title: Your Hand Stops
steal_consequence.text:
The grain is heavy in your palm.
You cannot betray such trust.

choices.feedback: You set it back. Peace returns.

boast_consequence.title: Cold Glances
boast_consequence.text:
The other servants turn from you.
Your words have made enemies.

choices.text: Kneel and give God the glory
choices.feedback: Humility softens what pride broke.

trusted.title: Set Over All
trusted.text:
"All I have is in your hand," Potiphar says.
He makes you steward of his house.

choices.text: Use the wealth for your comfort
choices.feedback: His trust is not yours to spend.
Genesis 39:4 — Potiphar made Joseph overseer of his house and put all that he had into his hand.

wealth_consequence.title: A Quiet Warning
wealth_consequence.text:
You feel the weight of his eyes.
Greed will undo you.

choices.feedback: You return to your duties.

diligent.title: Blessing in the House
diligent.text:
The fields, the storehouse, the table — all flourish.
The Lord blesses for your sake.

choices.text: Pray and thank God each day
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:5 — The Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake, and the blessing of the Lord was on all that he had in the house and in the field.
The blessing is not yours to claim.

credit_consequence.title: A Hollow Praise
credit_consequence.text:
Their praise tastes like dust.
God alone deserves the glory.

choices.text: Pray and give thanks to God
choices.feedback: You bow your head in private.

noticed.title: Her Eyes Linger
noticed.text:
Potiphar's wife watches you each day.
Her smile is warm, too warm.

choices.feedback: A small flame can burn a house.

choices.text: Keep your eyes lowered, work on
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:7 — Potiphar's wife cast longing eyes on Joseph.

smile_consequence.title: She Steps Closer
smile_consequence.text:
Your kindness has been read as want.
This is not the path.

choices.text: Withdraw and keep your eyes low
choices.feedback: You step back from the fire.

first_advance.title: "Lie With Me"
first_advance.text:
She whispers it openly. Her hand finds yours.
The room grows still.

choices.text: Refuse — "How can I sin against God?"
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:8-9 — Joseph refused Potiphar's wife, stating he could not do this great wickedness and sin against God.
To weigh sin is to invite it.
God sees what no man sees.

weigh_consequence.title: Her Grip Tightens
weigh_consequence.text:
Hesitation is half a yes.
You must speak the truth now.

choices.feedback: You pull your hand away.

yield_consequence.title: A Voice Inside
yield_consequence.text:
Before her lips meet yours, conscience cries out.
You pull back.

choices.feedback: "I cannot sin against God."

she_persists.title: Day After Day
she_persists.text:
She speaks to you each morning.
Each evening she waits in the hall.

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:10 — Potiphar's wife spoke to Joseph day after day, but he did not listen to her, to lie with her or to be with her.
Anger may shame her into hatred.
Who would believe a slave?

confront_consequence.title: Her Face Hardens
confront_consequence.text:
Pride wounded turns to spite.
You must walk softly now.

choices.feedback: You change your paths in the house.

tell_consequence.title: He Cannot Hear It
tell_consequence.text:
Potiphar waves you away, troubled.
A slave's word is small.

choices.text: Avoid her presence from now on
choices.feedback: You will simply not be near her.

the_empty_house.title: No One Within
the_empty_house.text:
The servants are gone for the feast.
You enter the hall to do your work.

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:11 — Joseph went into the house to do his work when none of the men of the house were inside.
Quiet houses are not always safe.

linger_consequence.title: A Door Opens
linger_consequence.text:
Soft footsteps in the corridor.
You should have gone.

choices.feedback: You turn for the door.

she_grabs.title: She Catches Your Garment
she_grabs.text:
Her hand closes on your cloak.
"Lie with me!" she demands.

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:12 — Joseph left his garment in her hand and fled and got out of the house.
She will tear it and call it proof.

choices.text: Yield this once to keep peace
choices.feedback: There is no peace in such a sin.

wrestle_consequence.title: The Cloth Tears
wrestle_consequence.text:
She holds the torn piece, eyes bright.
Do not stay to argue.

choices.feedback: You let go and run for the door.

yield2_consequence.title: God Sees
yield2_consequence.text:
His eyes are upon you in this room.
You cannot do this thing.

choices.feedback: You break free and run.

fled.title: Out Into the Sun
fled.text:
You stand outside, breathing hard.
Your cloak is in her hand.

choices.text: Hide and wait for the truth
choices.feedback: Hiding only looks like guilt.

choices.text: Return to your duties in faith
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:10 — Joseph refused to lie beside her or be with her, continuing to go about his duties.

hide2_consequence.title: They Will Find You
hide2_consequence.text:
A slave cannot hide for long.
Better to walk in the open.

choices.text: Return to your duties in faith
choices.feedback: You square your shoulders and go.

her_cry.title: She Cries Out
her_cry.text:
She calls the servants, holding your cloak.
"The Hebrew tried to shame me!"

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:14-15 — Potiphar's wife called to the men of her household and accused Joseph, holding his garment as evidence.
Anger will only feed her story.
Flight is a confession.

shout_consequence.title: Their Faces Turn
shout_consequence.text:
Loud denial seems like guilt.
Be still. Trust God.

choices.feedback: You close your mouth in peace.

flee_consequence.title: Soldiers at the Gate
flee_consequence.text:
You will not outrun Potiphar's guard.
Face this with faith.

choices.feedback: You walk back, head bowed.

before_potiphar.title: His Wrath Burns
before_potiphar.text:
Potiphar holds the torn cloak.
His eyes are dark with anger.

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:19-20 — When Potiphar heard his wife's story, his anger was kindled, and he put Joseph into the prison.
His mind is set. Words will not turn it.
Such words could cost your head.

beg_consequence.title: He Will Not Hear
beg_consequence.text:
Your pleading falls on stone.
Only silence will keep your life.

choices.feedback: You lower yourself to the floor.

curse_consequence.title: The Guards Step Forward
curse_consequence.text:
Steel rings half from the sheath.
Close your mouth before it costs all.

choices.feedback: You drop to your knees in silence.

to_prison.title: Bound for the Prison
to_prison.text:
Ropes bind your wrists.
They lead you toward the king's prison.

choices.text: Walk in faith — God is with you
choices.feedback: You lift your eyes to heaven.

ending.title: The Lord Was With Him
ending.text:
The gates close behind you.
Yet even here, the Lord shows you mercy.
